products.text:
Type: three-light linear pendant chandelier
Use: light over a dining table or island; dining room, kitchen
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: pipe-style metal frame in gunmetal finish, clear glass drum shades
Colors: dark gunmetal black, clear glass
Shape: horizontal pipe bar on two downrods, three sockets with wide short clear drum shades, exposed bulbs, long and linear, medium visual weight
Feel: utilitarian, warm, open
Goes with: reclaimed wood tables, white or brick walls, black metal accents; industrial or farmhouse dining rooms

Type: brass sputnik rod chandelier
Use: statement light over a dining table or living area; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, modern, minimalist
Materials: metal rods in brushed brass finish, exposed bulbs
Colors: warm brass, clear bulbs
Shape: crossing straight horizontal rods at staggered levels, six bare bulb sockets on rod ends, single downrod with round canopy, wide, linear and airy
Feel: graphic, warm, airy, sculptural
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, black or green accents; mid-century or modern dining rooms

Type: vintage glass dome pendant light
Use: light over a dining table or island; dining room, kitchen, entryway
Style: industrial, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: metal in oil-rubbed bronze, clear glass bell shade, exposed filament bulb
Colors: dark bronze, clear glass
Shape: small clear dome shade, yoke-style bracket with knobs, turned stem on downrod, compact
Feel: nostalgic, warm, crafted
Goes with: wood tables, white subway tile, dark metal accents; farmhouse or industrial rooms

Type: industrial metal hood pendant
Use: focused light over a dining table or island; dining room, kitchen
Style: industrial, farmhouse, modern
Materials: brushed nickel metal, diffuser lens
Colors: cool silver nickel
Shape: tall bell hood shade with bottom rim and screw details, yoke bracket with knobs, downrod, compact but solid
Feel: utilitarian, clean, sturdy
Goes with: grey or white cabinets, stainless steel, wood tables; industrial or modern farmhouse rooms

Type: clear glass bell pendant light
Use: light over a dining table or nightstand; dining room, bedroom, entryway
Style: modern, farmhouse, industrial
Materials: clear blown glass shade, black metal socket, fabric cord
Colors: clear glass, black
Shape: tapered glass shade with rounded bulbous neck, exposed filament bulb, hangs from cord, light and transparent
Feel: airy, simple, warm
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, black accents; modern farmhouse or contemporary rooms

Type: matte gray dome pendant
Use: light over a dining table or desk; dining room, home office, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: powder-coated metal shade, fabric cord
Colors: soft light gray
Shape: smooth dome shade with cylindrical neck and thin rim, hangs from cord, compact and clean
Feel: calm, soft, understated
Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel accents; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

Type: drum shade pendant chandelier
Use: overhead light over a dining table or bed; dining room, bedroom, living room
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: white fabric drum shade, black metal frame
Colors: off-white, black
Shape: wide shallow drum shade, four candle-style arms with finial below, long downrod, broad, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, elegant, balanced
Goes with: neutral walls, dark wood, linen fabrics; transitional or classic rooms

Type: five-light cone shade chandelier
Use: overhead light over a dining table or living area; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, retro, modern
Materials: matte black metal shades and ring, copper-bronze finish rods and bands
Colors: matte black, warm copper
Shape: circular ring holding five flared cone shades with copper bands, three angled rods to central downrod, round and medium weight
Feel: bold, warm, graphic
Goes with: walnut wood, white or dark walls, copper accents; mid-century or retro rooms

Type: frosted glass flush-mount ceiling light
Use: general overhead light; bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: frosted glass bowl, bronze metal trim and finial
Colors: white frosted glass, dark bronze
Shape: low round bowl shade with stepped bronze rim, small finial at center, mounts flush, compact and low profile
Feel: soft, practical, familiar
Goes with: beige walls, wood furniture, bronze hardware; traditional rooms

Type: clear glass semi-flush ceiling light
Use: overhead light; bedroom, hallway, dining room
Style: farmhouse, industrial, traditional

Colors: dark bronze, clear glass
